That's not a game number. In real life, about twenty million American adults owe medical debt.
At least two hundred and twenty billion dollars between them.

Mo is on a bed with his arm in a cast.
He doesn't blink back healed. He just sits there, pale, with
six weeks of cast ahead of him, and his own bill on the table.
Five thousand, eight hundred dollars."
It's fine," Mo says." It's only six weeks."
